svg.aria-label: Which ways of drawing a widget survive which notebook front end
svg.text: Twelve ways to draw a widget from a Java kernel, and how much of each one is left in four places.
A saved notebook nobody has run keeps 4 of the 12. No script, no style tag, no ids, and every form control arrives disabled.
So the widget has to be legible before it is interactive, and details and summary is the only interaction that always works.
linux-x64, osx-arm64, java 27+35-2325, jjava 1.0a8, jupyterlab 4.6.3, measured 2026-09-02
